comments.body: Duplicate of #1611: same 1-ulp EM_E_x mismatch from gcc fusing the Ohm ideal term differently in the vector and scalar versions of the loop. With -n 2 each level-0 patch's y-row has 17 nodes, so the scalar leftover node is y=16 on one patch and y=32 ≡ 0 on the other, which are the rows reported here
